title: Constant subsheaf quotient gluing
statement: Let X be a topological space, K and C abelian sheaves, and let a monomorphism K -> C identify C with the constant integer sheaf [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]. Fix a finite family of opens A_i, natural labels 0 < c_i <= b+1, and sections s_i in K(A_i) mapping to the constant c_i in C(A_i). Let Q be any abelian sheaf and pi:K -> Q any morphism. Put U=union_i A_i and V=union_{c_i <= b} A_i. Suppose all stalks [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk] of Q on V are zero. Then there exists q:j_{U!}Z -> Q [def-sc-abelian-open-extension-by-zero] such that on every A_i with c_i=b+1 its canonical unit section maps to pi(s_i). No generating presentation of K or cokernel description of Q is assumed.

proof.text: Put W=union_{c_i=b+1} A_i. The bound on the labels gives U=W union V. For two top-labelled indices the images of their sections in C agree on the intersection by naturality of the constant-sheaf unit. The component of a sheaf monomorphism is injective, so their restrictions in K agree as well. Their images under pi form a compatible family.

Use Mathlib TopCat.Sheaf.existsUnique_gluing to glue these images to t_W in Q(W). The restriction of Q to V has all stalks zero, so Mathlib TopCat.Sheaf.isZero_iff_stalkFunctor_obj_isZero makes it zero. In particular t_W restricts to zero on W intersect V. Glue t_W with zero on V to a section t in Q(U).

On the open subspace U send the integer generator to t, using the constant-sheaf adjunction (the presheaf map sends an integer m to m times the restriction of t, and factors through sheafification). To extend it by zero, send each summand of abelianOpenExtensionPresheaf U to the corresponding restriction of t and use sheafifyLift. Naturality of restrictions ensures this is a presheaf map. The sheafification unit equation gives the displayed value of q on every top-labelled unit section. Empty families are handled by the empty-cover gluing axiom.
